Common Questions

Are these calculators for US and UK users?

Yes. The site is written for English-language users, with many tools useful for US and UK everyday searches.

Do I need an account?

No. Calculators run in the browser and do not require sign up.

Are the results professional advice?

No. Use results as planning aids and verify important decisions with qualified sources.

How do I find a calculator?

Search from the homepage or open a category page, then choose the calculator link from its grouped directory.

Can I use the converters on mobile?

Yes. Pages are responsive and built for quick use on phones, tablets, and desktops.

Why group calculators inside each category?

Groups make large category pages easier to scan while still keeping each calculator one click away.
